name: blender
description: Blender Python and asset export as of Blender 5.x: a stdlib checker for bpy calls the target version removed or renamed (action.fcurves, scene.node_tree, BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT, bgl, Geometry Nodes Socket_N keys) that also reads .blend header versions, an in-Blender mesh QA script with a real exit code, the headless --python-exit-code traps, and FBX/glTF export rules for Unreal, Unity and Godot.

cc_bpy_check.title: bpy removal check (CC_BPY_CHECK)
cc_bpy_check.description: Run check_bpy_scripts.py on a written .py that imports bpy, and add the removed or deprecated calls it finds: on or off. The environment variable CC_BPY_CHECK overrides this.
